contentText:
Brent Lang / Variety :

Amazon MGM's Project Hail Mary becomes its highest-grossing film ever, crossing $300M globally, including $54.1M just this weekend; the movie cost $200M to make   —  “Project Hail Mary” is officially Amazon MGM's highest-grossing film ever.  —  The space odyssey has grossed $300.8 million globally …
